title: DN Dental Clinic Booking Platform
description: Full-stack dental clinic management system with appointment booking and patient management
longDescription: Leading the Spring Boot backend development for a comprehensive dental clinic management platform. The system features patient registration, appointment scheduling, treatment tracking, and billing integration. Implemented secure authentication with JWT, deployed on AWS with Docker containerization, and set up CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins. The platform serves multiple clinic locations with real-time appointment synchronization.

title: Employee Turnover Prediction (ML)
description: Machine learning model predicting employee turnover using ensemble methods
longDescription: Developed an advanced machine learning solution for predicting employee turnover using ensemble KNN and Random Forest models. The project involved extensive data preprocessing, feature engineering, and hyperparameter tuning to achieve high prediction accuracy. Identified key retention indicators and provided actionable insights for HR departments. Published research paper on ResearchGate detailing methodology and findings.

title: Hotel Booking Microservices Platform
description: Scalable hotel booking system built with Spring Boot microservices architecture
longDescription: Designing and implementing a distributed hotel booking system using microservices architecture. Each service (user management, booking, payment, inventory) is independently deployable and communicates via REST APIs. Implemented service discovery, API gateway, and distributed transaction management. Using PostgreSQL for data persistence and React for the frontend interface.

title: Real-Time Network Monitoring Tool
description: Java-based network monitoring application with real-time visualization
longDescription: Built a comprehensive network monitoring tool using Java and JavaFX for real-time network traffic analysis. Implemented socket programming for packet capture and analysis, created intuitive visualizations for network statistics, and developed alert mechanisms for anomaly detection. Features include bandwidth monitoring, protocol analysis, and connection tracking.

title: E-Commerce Web Application
description: Full-featured e-commerce platform with Spring Boot and React
longDescription: Developed a complete e-commerce solution featuring product catalog, shopping cart, user authentication, and order management. Implemented secure payment processing, inventory tracking, and admin dashboard for managing products and orders. Used Spring Boot for RESTful APIs, React for dynamic frontend, and MySQL for data persistence.

title: Point of Sale System (WPF)
description: Desktop POS application built with C# and WPF
longDescription: Created a comprehensive Point of Sale system for retail businesses using C# and WPF. Features include inventory management, sales tracking, receipt printing, and reporting capabilities. Implemented SQLite for local data storage, barcode scanning integration, and user role management for multiple staff members.

title: Blood Bank Management System
description: Database management system for blood bank operations
longDescription: Designed and implemented a comprehensive database system for blood bank management. The system handles donor registration, blood inventory tracking, donation scheduling, and recipient matching. Implemented advanced SQL features including indexing for query optimization, transactions for data integrity, and stored procedures for complex operations.
